name: Cover: poster panel
description: A poster-style cover: the left third is a solid colour panel with the kicker set vertically inside it; on the right a 168px extra-bold title and one subtitle along the bottom. A centred title slide would lose the impact of a block of colour hitting the eye first.

kicker.hint: occasion or series name, set vertically, 4 to 12 characters

title.hint: claim headline, up to 3 lines, up to 6 characters per line

subtitle.hint: one fact that supports the claim, up to 60 characters

subtitle.value: Last quarter six decks averaged four rounds; three of them touched only layout.
